inputs.name: reportServerEnvironment.port
inputs.description: The TCP port used for the loopback server. It is written to PORT and ORIGIN without numeric range validation.

inputs.name: reportServerEnvironment.base
inputs.description: The inherited environment variables copied into the server environment before server-specific values are set. HARNESS_SITE_ROOT is preserved when present.

inputs.name: reportServerEnvironment.cwd
inputs.description: The repository working directory used for HARNESS_SITE_ROOT when base.HARNESS_SITE_ROOT is nullish.

inputs.name: ReportServerService.constructor.repository
inputs.description: The ReportRepository instance whose root identifies the report store for health matching and server records. Defaults to new ReportRepository().

inputs.name: ReportServerService.serve.preferred
inputs.description: The first loopback port checked by serve; it checks this port and the next 29, reusing a matching server or starting on the first free port. The implementation does not validate or clamp this range.

inputs.name: ReportServerService.stop.port
inputs.description: The port whose recorded server for this repository is stopped; a server not started for this store is left alone. Defaults to 5588.

outputs.name: reportServerEnvironment
outputs.description: The loopback server environment copies base, sets HOST and HARNESS_BIND to 127.0.0.1, stringifies PORT, sets the matching HTTP ORIGIN, BODY_SIZE_LIMIT to 110M, and HARNESS_OWNER_MODE to loopback. HARNESS_SITE_ROOT keeps base.HARNESS_SITE_ROOT unless it is nullish, then uses cwd.

outputs.name: ReportServerService.serve
outputs.type: Promise<{ port: number; reused: boolean; url: string; pid: number | undefined; }>
outputs.description: Resolves to an object with port, reused, url, and pid; url is the loopback HTTP address and reused indicates whether a matching server was already running. pid is the recorded pid on reuse, or the spawned pid (falling back to -1) on start, and can be undefined when a reused record has no pid.

outputs.name: ReportServerService.stop
outputs.description: Resolves with the StoppedServer value returned by stopReportServer for this repository root and port.

examples.reason: This report store recorded no server on this port.
The recorded server had already ended.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: serve throws Error when no free port is found in the 30-port range or a started server fails its readiness check. Errors from startup, build identity, and server-record operations can also reject serve.
